title: [Alex's Caves + EveryMole] Extra Underzealot Sacrifices
description: Adds new sacrifices using Every Mole mod for the Underzealots in Alex's Caves.
body:
**Extra Underzealot Sacrifices** is a small datapack made to be used with the mod [Every Mole](https://modrinth.com/mod/everymole), it includes different rituals that the Underzealots in [Alex's Caves](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-caves) will be able to do besides the two classic ones. Some of the mobs come from other mods different from Alex's Caves, you will have to install them otherwise the result of the sacrifice will be a pig! If you have [Just Enough Breeding](https://modrinth.com/mod/justenoughbreeding) installed, you can see all sacrifices in the game.
Sacrifices List - Bat to Vesper - Gossamer Worm to Hullbreaker - Mooshroom to Shimmercow (requires [Aether Redux](https://modrinth.com/mod/galosphere)) - Crab to Amethyst Crab (requires [Quark](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark) & [L_Ender's Cataclysm](https://modrinth.com/mod/l_enders-cataclysm)) - Coconut Crab to Amethyst Crab (requires [Ecologics](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark) & [L_Ender's Cataclysm](https://modrinth.com/mod/l_enders-cataclysm)) - Helmet Crab to Amethyst Crab (requires [The Twilight Forest](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark) & [L_Ender's Cataclysm](https://modrinth.com/mod/l_enders-cataclysm)) - Blaze to Ignited Berserker (requires [L_Ender's Cataclysm](https://modrinth.com/mod/l_enders-cataclysm)) - Ghast to Ur-ghast (requires [The Twilight Forest](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark)) - Evoker to Invoker (requires [Illager Invasion](https://modrinth.com/mod/illager-invasion)) - Crab to Amethyst Crab (requires [Seafarer](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/seafarer-forge) and [L_Ender's Cataclysm](https://modrinth.com/mod/l_enders-cataclysm)) - Angler Fish to AnglerFish (requires [Spawn](https://modrinth.com/mod/spawn-mod) and [Aquamirae](https://modrinth.com/mod/aquamirae)) - Maw to Eel (requires [Aquamirae](https://modrinth.com/mod/aquamirae)) - Preserved to Berserker (requires [Galosphere](https://modrinth.com/mod/galosphere)) - Snail to Mykapod (requires [Spawn](https://modrinth.com/mod/spawn-mod) and [Aether Redux](https://modrinth.com/mod/galosphere)) - Thrasher to Great Thrasher (requires [Upgrade Aquatic](https://modrinth.com/mod/upgrade-aquatic)) - Wisp to Apparition (requires [Jaden's Nether Expansion](https://modrinth.com/mod/jadens-nether-expansion)) - AnglerFish to AnglerFish (requires Tide and [Aquamirae](https://modrinth.com/mod/aquamirae))
--- You can remove any sacrifice by deleting any of the json files from the datapack. This datapack has been created because there are some mobs from these mods that for some reason never or rarely spawn and I thought of an interesting way to be able to access them at least. (Although there are others that I have added for fun.) ---
